title: FLA import: Scene 5 imports 2 frames / 'menu' label on frame 2 — should be 1 frame / frame 1
description:
RESOLVED — interpretation (a): the import is FAITHFUL; there is NO phantom keyframe. Settled from raw bytes (no Flash 8 VM needed).

EVIDENCE (Page 5 stream, 3328 B): the 'Ball' layer physically contains TWO distinct, fully-formed CPicFrame records:
  frame[0]: dur=1 keyMode=0x600 label='' script='' elements=0 (leading EMPTY keyframe; its empty label BomString sits ~0x6db)
  frame[1]: dur=1 keyMode=0x600 label='menu' script='stop()' elements=3 (Symbol 2 instance + Symbol 9 instance + static text; 'menu'+'stop()' BomStrings at ~0x736/~0x755)
Both label BomStrings were located in the byte stream, proving the parser is NOT fabricating frame[0]. The frameId in readTimelineSubObject is a RANDOM id (skipped), not an absolute frame index, so a keyframe's timeline position is derived solely from preceding CPicFrame durations -> 2 records = 2 keyframes = scene span 2. Real Flash 8 reading the same file would likewise show a blank keyframe at frame 1 and content at frame 2.

So: tryLoadRealFla(Magnet.fla).scenes[1] reproduces ground truth EXACTLY (Ball: empty@idx0 + menu/stop@idx1, frameCount=2; scene span=2; 'menu' labelType=name; 3 displayObjects). The QA 'should be 1 frame / menu on frame 1' is an OFF-BY-ONE recollection (UI frame 2 = 0-based model index 1); frame 1 is genuinely BLANK in the authored .fla.

FIX (no product code changed — forcing '1 frame' would falsify the file & break save/round-trip fidelity): replaced the misleadingly-named magnet-inspect.test.ts 'has menu frame label in Scene 5 at frame 1' (which hard-coded frame.index===1 with a wrong title) with a rigorous structural regression 'Scene 5 Ball layer imports its full ground-truth frame count + menu label (task 1342)'. It DERIVES the expectation from raw parseFla8Timeline of the Page 5 stream (asserts Ball=2 frames, scene span=2, menu at raw idx1 w/ stop()+3 elements, frame0 empty) and asserts the model import matches it (frame count parity, menu index/label/script/displayObjects, leading empty kf at idx0, exactly one 'menu' label). Does NOT regress 1341's mask test.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build = green. @flash/core suite = 5518 passed / 2 failed; both failures are the pre-existing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla ENOENT (carchive-validate, contents-structure, empty-bytematch) — that fixture is absent from the ENTIRE repo (gitignored task-1207 fixtures), unrelated to this task. magnet-inspect.test.ts: 5/5 pass. FLA import+roundtrip+framescript: 203/203 pass.
